ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERNAME_CCD
AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName
AS(
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId,CustomerNameId ORDER BY INSERTDTTM DESC ) RN, * FROM (
--(1)CONCAT
SELECT
BCM.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
,HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(BCM.CUST_FIRST_NAME, BCM.CUST_MIDDLE_NAME, BCM.CUST_LAST_NAME)) AS CustomerNameId
,NULL AS NameUsageId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCM.CUST_DATE_MAINT)) AS StartDate
,NULL AS EndDate
,NULL AS CustomerNameNote
,BCM.BNK_CODE AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID
,BCMD.RECORD_STATUS
,BCM.INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM

FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER_DELTA BCMD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCM ON BCM.CUST_NBR = BCMD.CUST_NBR AND BCM.ISLATEST = '1'

UNION

SELECT
BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
,HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(BCD.CUST_FIRST_NAME, BCD.CUST_MIDDLE_NAME, BCD.CUST_LAST_NAME)) AS CustomerNameId
,NULL AS NameUsageId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCD.CUST_DATE_MAINT)) AS StartDate
,NULL AS EndDate
,NULL AS CustomerNameNote
,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID
,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
,BCD.INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD ON BCD.CUST_NBR = BCDD.CUST_NBR AND BCD.ISLATEST = '1'

UNION
--(2) ENGLISH NAME
SELECT
BCM.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
,HASHBYTES('MD5',BCM.CUST_ENG_NAME) AS CustomerNameId
,'ENGLISH NAME' AS NameUsageId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCM.CUST_DATE_MAINT)) AS StartDate
,NULL AS EndDate
,NULL AS CustomerNameNote
,BCM.BNK_CODE AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID
,BCMD.RECORD_STATUS
,BCM.INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER_DELTA BCMD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCM ON BCM.CUST_NBR = BCMD.CUST_NBR AND BCM.ISLATEST = '1'

UNION

SELECT
BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
,HASHBYTES('MD5',BCD.CUST_ENG_NAME) AS CustomerNameId
,'ENGLISH NAME' AS NameUsageId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCD.CUST_DATE_MAINT)) AS StartDate
,NULL AS EndDate
,NULL AS CustomerNameNote
,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID
,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
,BCD.INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD ON BCD.CUST_NBR = BCDD.CUST_NBR AND BCD.ISLATEST = '1'
)A
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName WHERE RN = 1;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,CustomerNameId
,NameUsageId
,StartDate
,EndDate
,CustomerNameNote
,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID
)) HASHROW,CustomerId,CustomerNameId,NameUsageId,FinancialInstitutionId,RECORD_STATUS
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,CustomerNameId
,NameUsageId
,StartDate
,EndDate
,CustomerNameNote
,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID
,SourceSystemCode 
)) HASHROW,CustomerId,CustomerNameId,NameUsageId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerName WHERE EndDate IS NULL AND SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_DELTA
AS(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId, TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerNameId, TGT.CustomerNameId) AS CustomerNameId
,ISNULL(SRC.NameUsageId, TGT.NameUsageId) AS NameUsageId
,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId, TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
,CASE
    WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
    ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_TGT TGT
ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.CustomerNameId = TGT.CustomerNameId
AND SRC.NameUsageId = TGT.NameUsageId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_DELTA;

--UPDATE RECORDS TO BNKM

UPDATE TGT
SET
EndDate = CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.StartDate))
FROM BNKM.CustomerName TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND DELTA.CustomerNameId = TGT.CustomerNameId AND DELTA.NameUsageId = TGT.NameUsageId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND SRC.CustomerNameId = TGT.CustomerNameId AND SRC.NameUsageId = TGT.NameUsageId AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE TGT.EndDate IS NULL


--INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerName
(
CustomerId
,CustomerNameId
,NameUsageId
,StartDate
,EndDate
,CustomerNameNote
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT
SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,SRC.CustomerNameId AS CustomerNameId
,SRC.NameUsageId AS NameUsageId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.StartDate)) AS StartDate
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.EndDate)) AS EndDate
,SRC.CustomerNameNote AS CustomerNameNote
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE' AND DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId AND DELTA.CustomerNameId = SRC.CustomerNameId AND DELTA.NameUsageId = SRC.NameUsageId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId


--INSERT RECCORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerName
(
CustomerId
,CustomerNameId
,NameUsageId
,StartDate
,EndDate
,CustomerNameNote
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT
CustomerId
,CustomerNameId
,NameUsageId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,StartDate))
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,EndDate))
,CustomerNameNote
,FinancialInstitutionId
,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_DELTA;

END
